1713.name: Determined Resolution
1713.description: Strike damage taken is reduced by a percentage while you have resolution.

1714.name: Pact of Pain
1714.description: Conditions you apply to foes last longer, but conditions applied to you also last longer.

1715.name: Brutality
1715.description: Gain quickness when you swap weapons. Deal increased damage to foes with stability or protection.

1716.name: Rising Momentum
1716.description: Gain increased movement speed for each point of upkeep currently in use.

1719.name: Roiling Mists
1719.description: Critical-hit chance is further increased while you are under the effect of fury. Convert a percentage of your outgoing critical strike damage into healing.

1720.name: Fiendish Tenacity
1720.description: <c=@abilitytype>Invoke Torment</c> grants resistance. Resistance heals you every interval.

1721.name: Permeating Pestilence
1721.description: <c=@abilitytype>Invoke Torment</c> transfers conditions from you onto foes.

1724.name: Destructive Impulses
1724.description: All damage dealt is increased, and increased additionally if you have an off-hand weapon equipped.

1726.name: Demonic Resistance
1726.description: Incoming strike damage is reduced while you have resistance on you.

1727.name: Abyssal Chill
1727.description: When you chill a foe, you also inflict torment on them.

1728.name: Close Quarters
1728.description: Reduce strike damage dealt to you from foes beyond the range threshold.

1730.name: Hardening Persistence
1730.description: Strike damage taken is reduced for each point of upkeep currently in use. Shield skills remove conditions.

1732.name: Cleansing Channel
1732.description: Invoking a legend removes a condition.

1738.name: Shared Empowerment
1738.description: When applying a boon to an ally, also apply might to nearby allies.

1740.name: Dwarven Battle Training
1740.description:
Deal increased strike damage to weakened foes. Disabling a foe applies weakness.
Disables include stun, daze, knockback, pull, knockdown, sink, float, fear, taunt, and launch.

1741.name: Replenishing Despair
1741.description: Siphon health from nearby enemies when you gain a dark aura. Siphon healing is reduced for each target struck beyond the first.

1744.name: Yearning Empowerment
1744.description: Damaging conditions you apply last longer.

1746.name: Elevated Compassion
1746.description:
Heal allies when you grant them boons. Grant boons to allies when your upkeep cost is equal to or higher than the threshold.
An ally can only be affected by this skill once per interval.

1749.name: Song of the Mists
1749.description: Invoking a legend casts a skill based on the legend you invoked. <c=@reminder>Invoking Razah casts the skill associated with the legend you have equipped in your other slot instead. </c>

1754.name: Dance of Death
1754.description: Applying vulnerability to foes grants stacks of <c=@abilitytype>Battle Scars</c>. The healing from Battle Scars is increased while you are below the health threshold.

1755.name: Battle Scarred
1755.description: Siphon health after using your healing skill.

1757.name: Unwavering Avoidance
1757.description: Gain vigor when successfully evading an attack.

1758.name: Ferocious Aggression
1758.description: All damage dealt is increased while you have fury.

1760.name: Rapid Flow
1760.description: Heal yourself and gain swiftness when you use a skill that has an energy cost.

1761.name: Rising Tide
1761.description: While your health is above the threshold, strike damage dealt is increased.

1765.name: Notoriety
1765.description: Might grants you more power and less condition damage. Gain might when using a legendary stance skill.

1766.name: Set in Stone
1766.description:
Gain protection when you use your profession skill 2.
This trait affects True Nature when you are a herald.

1767.name: Unsuspecting Strikes
1767.description: Deal increased strike damage to foes with health above the health threshold.

1769.name: Contained Temper
1769.description: Gain energy when you break stun.

1770.name: Versed in Stone
1770.description: Rite of the Great Dwarf reduces damage by an additional amount. When struck below the health threshold, cast Rite of the Great Dwarf. Gain power based on your toughness.

1772.name: Draconic Echo
1772.description: You retain your <c=@abilitytype>facet</c> passives for a duration after using their <c=@abilitytype>consume</c> skills. Your <c=@abilitytype>facet</c> passives grant you additional bonuses.

1774.name: Spirit Boon
1774.description: Invoking a legend grants boons to nearby allies based on the legend that was invoked.

1776.name: Aggressive Arrival
1776.description: Gain resistance when you invoke a legend.

1777.name: Crystal Harbinger
1777.description: You can now use <c=@abilitytype>Legendary Dragon</c> skills and gain access to Facet of Nature.

1778.name: Invoker's Rage
1778.description: Gain fury when you invoke a legend.

1779.name: Vicious Reprisal
1779.description: While you have resolution, all damage dealt is increased, and you gain might when you strike foes. Resolution granted to you lasts longer.

1781.name: Incensed Response
1781.description: Gain might when you grant yourself fury.

1784.name: Glaring Resolve
1784.description: Gain stability and heal yourself when you break stuns.

1786.name: Assassin's Presence
1786.description: While you are in combat, grant fury to yourself and nearby allies each interval.

1788.name: Reinforced Potency
1788.description: Gain concentration and deal increased strike damage for each active boon you have.

1789.name: Demonic Defiance
1789.description: Gain resistance and remove a damaging condition when you use a <c=@abilitytype>Legendary Demon</c> skill.

1790.name: Steadfast Rejuvenation
1790.description: Heal every second for each point of upkeep currently in use.

1791.name: Charged Mists
1791.description: Invoking a legend while at or below the energy threshold grants extra energy to your new legend.

1792.name: Targeted Destruction
1792.description: Deal increased strike damage to targets based on their vulnerability stacks.

1799.name: Invoking Torment
1799.description: Release a burst of torment energy when you switch legends.

1800.name: Swift Termination
1800.description: Deal increased strike damage to foes below the health threshold.

1802.name: Thrill of Combat
1802.description: Gain stacks of <c=@abilitytype>Battle Scars</c> while in combat.

1803.name: Forceful Persistence
1803.description:
Deal increased strike damage with active upkeep skills.
Herald and weapon upkeep skills grant less damage but can be stacked.

1806.name: Core Value
1806.description: Improve the effects of the True Nature skill.

1808.name: Expose Defenses
1808.description: Your first attack when entering combat applies vulnerability. This ability is refreshed when you use an elite skill.

1810.name: Spiritual Reckoning
1810.description: Gain resolution when you use invoke a legend.

1811.name: Planar Protection
1811.description: Cast Dome of the Mists when you use a healing skill.

1813.name: Elder's Respite
1813.description: Regeneration heals for more. Gain regeneration when struck while below the health threshold.

1814.name: Serene Rejuvenation
1814.description: Increase healing to other allies. <c=@abilitytype>Legendary Centaur</c> skills apply boons in an area.

1815.name: Generous Abundance
1815.description:
Heal allies around yourself when using a Legend skill. Heal allies around Ventari's Tablet when using a Legendary Centaur skill.
Dragon Facet skills and Ventari's Will cannot activate this trait.

1816.name: Healer's Gift
1816.description: The end of your dodge roll heals nearby allies.

1817.name: Resilient Spirit
1817.description: Periodically gain barrier for each unique boon you have.

1818.name: Fortified Blessing
1818.description: Grant protection when you remove a condition from an ally.

1819.name: Words of Censure
1819.description:
Blinding, immobilizing, or affecting a foe with crowd control heals nearby allies.
Skills that strike many foes at the same time can heal multiple times.

1820.name: Invigorating Dismissal
1820.description: Grant endurance when you remove a condition from an ally.

1821.name: Life Attunement
1821.description: Gain healing power. Gain concentration based on a portion of your healing power.

1822.name: Eluding Nullification
1822.description: The end of your dodge roll removes a condition from nearby allies.

1823.name: Invoking Harmony
1823.description: Healing done to other allies is increased for a short duration after invoking a legend.

1824.name: Blinding Truths
1824.description: Blind nearby foes when you use a healing skill.

1825.name: Unyielding Devotion
1825.description: Take reduced strike damage for a duration after healing. Lasts longer if you heal an ally other than yourself.

2079.name: Blood Fury
2079.description: Fury increases the duration of bleeds you inflict. Gaining fury inspires you with Kalla's Fervor.

2092.name: Heartpiercer
2092.description: Bleeding you inflict deals more damage. Deal increased strike damage to bleeding foes.

2094.name: Vindication
2094.description: Kalla's Fervor causes you to heal for a percentage of your outgoing damage. Citadel Bombardment dazes enemies the first time that it strikes them.

2100.name: Lasting Legacy
2100.description: Kalla's Fervor you inspire lasts longer and is more potent. Heroic Command grants more might per stack of Kalla's Fervor.

2108.name: All for One
2108.description: When you trigger <c=@abilitytype>Band Together</c>, gain energy and reduce the recharge of the enhanced skill.

2120.name: Wrought-Iron Will
2120.description: Evading an attack inspires you with Kalla's Fervor and grants boons to nearby allies.

2142.name: Brutal Momentum
2142.description: Gain increased critical-hit chance. This bonus is increased further while your endurance is full. Gain vigor when you gain fury.

2154.name: Endless Enmity
2154.description: Grant fury to yourself and nearby allies when you critically strike a foe.

2166.name: Ashen Demeanor
2166.description: Gain might, resistance, and Kalla's Fervor when you use a healing skill.

2181.name: Ambush Commander
2181.description:
When you critically strike, attack your enemies from behind or their flanks, or strike a defiant foe, you'll inspire yourself with Kalla's Fervor.
Gain access to Citadel Order skills.

2182.name: Righteous Rebel
2182.description: Kalla's Fervor increases your healing to other allies. Orders from Above lasts longer, heals allies, and affects a larger area.

2228.name: Redemptor's Sermon
2228.description: When you use a healing skill, heal allies in the area and grant them protection.

2229.name: Empire Divided
2229.description: Gain increased power while above the health threshold. Gain increased healing power when below it.

2232.name: Vassals of the Empire
2232.description: Dodging now grants boons to allies and strikes foes when landing.

2238.name: Saint of zu Heltzer
2238.description: The affected area of your dodge is increased. You now heal allies in an area when you land instead of dealing damage. Outgoing healing is increased for a period of time upon landing.

2243.name: Angsiyan's Trust
2243.description: Energy Meld no longer has an energy cost and grants energy when used in combat.

2248.name: Amnesty of Shing Jea
2248.description:
Legendary Alliance abilities gain an additional bonus. Activating Energy Meld or Alliance Tactics grants both of these bonuses simultaneously at greater amounts to nearby allies.
Kurzick abilities grant regeneration.
Luxon abilities grant might.

2254.name: Balance in Discord
2254.description: Gain health and boons when swapping legends, or by using <c=@abilitytype>Alliance Tactics</c> while attuned to the Legendary Alliance.

2255.name: Song of Arboreum
2255.description: Energy Meld grants more endurance and grants its endurance and vigor to nearby allies.

2257.name: Forerunner of Death
2257.description: Dodging now deals more damage but affects a smaller area. Outgoing strike damage is increased for a period of time upon impact.

2258.name: Leviathan Strength
2258.description: Deal increased damage while your endurance is not full.

2259.name: Reaver's Curse
2259.description: Energy Meld's cooldown is reduced and it increases the effectiveness of your next dodge.

2262.name: Tenacious Ruin
2262.description: Instead of dodging, deliver a powerful blow from above, striking foes when you hit the ground.

2331.name: Bolstered Bonds
2331.description: Gain attributes based on your equipped legends. Those attributes are increased further when Cosmic Wisdom is active.

2352.name: Found Purpose
2352.description: Trigger the active portion of Numinous Gift when you invoke a legend while in combat. Triggering Numinous Gift grants boons to allies in an area around you, depending on which legends you have equipped.

2355.name: Shared Wisdom
2355.description: Grant boons to allies whenever you use a Legendary Entity Skill, depending on which skill was used.

2358.name: Expanded Consciousness
2358.description: Heal and gain endurance whenever you gain affinity. Additionally, gain energy when you reach maximum affinity.

2364.name: Enigmatic Connection
2364.description: Gain access to Release Potential, Cosmic Wisdom, and Legendary Entity Stance. The effects of Release Potential and Cosmic Wisdom change depending on which legend you are currently invoking. Gain affinity while using legend skills, which increases the effectiveness of Release Potential. Gain additional affinity when using legend skills above the threshold and while channeling an upkeep skill.

2379.name: Enhanced Embodiment
2379.description: Reduce the recharge of invoking legends in combat. Invoking legends while Cosmic Wisdom is active extends its duration.

2390.name: Conductive Armaments
2390.description: Gain affinity when using a weapon skill that costs energy.

2407.name: Lingering Determination
2407.description: Gain affinity when you invoke a different legend.

2411.name: Kinetic Insight
2411.description: The recharge of Release Potential skills is reduced. The effectiveness of Release Potential skills are increased as if you had two additional points of affinity, up to a maximum of five.

2416.name: Ethereal Purification
2416.description: Lose conditions when activating Cosmic Wisdom and at a set interval while Cosmic Wisdom is active.

2429.name: Mistfire
2429.description: Apply conditions to enemies when you disable them. Perform an additional strike when using Cosmic Wisdom that damages and burns enemies.

2440.name: Numinous Gift
2440.description: The third minor traits of other specializations you equip have improved effectiveness. Gain might and additional boons when you use Cosmic Wisdom, depending on which legends you have equipped.

26557.name: Vengeful Hammers
26557.description: Legendary Dwarf. Invoke hammers to circle around you, damaging foes.

26644.name: Facet of Strength
26644.description: Legendary Dragon. Facet. Place the Facet of Strength on yourself to grant nearby allies might every few seconds.

26666.name: Manifest Toxin
26666.description: Deliver a crushing blow that sends toxic energy chaining to enemies behind each target.

26679.name: Forced Engagement
26679.description: Legendary Dwarf. Launch a chain at your target. When the chain connects with a foe, it slows and taunts them. You take less damage from taunted foes.

26693.name: Resist the Darkness
26693.description: Legendary Demon. End Embrace the Darkness early.

26699.name: Unrelenting Assault
26699.description: Shadowstep and unleash fierce attacks on nearby foes. Gain might each time you damage a foe.

26730.name: Anguish Swipe
26730.description: Sweep your mace back for a second blow.

26821.name: Protective Solace
26821.description:
Legendary Centaur. Summon a protective barrier around the tablet that blocks enemy projectiles. 

If this skill is empowered, it also grants protection to allies around the tablet.

26937.name: Enchanted Daggers
26937.description: Legendary Assassin. Summon enchanted daggers that will attack as you attack, siphoning life from targets hit.

26956.name: Release Hammers
26956.description: Legendary Dwarf. Release the hammers to end Vengeful Hammers.

27014.name: Facet of Elements
27014.description: Legendary Dragon. Facet. Place the Facet of Elements on yourself to grant nearby allies swiftness every few seconds.

27025.name: Natural Harmony
27025.description:
Legendary Centaur. Collect energy, pulling it into the tablet to build up its power. After a short delay the energy will be released, healing nearby allies. 

If this skill is empowered, healing is increased and endurance is granted to affected allies.

27066.name: Misery Swipe
27066.description: Swing your mace at your foe.

27074.name: Deathstrike
27074.description: Shadowstep to your foe and deliver a quick attack, then deliver a second devastating blow if it hits.

27080.name: Gaze of Darkness
27080.description: Legendary Dragon. Consume. Consume Facet of Darkness to reveal the area around you, pulling foes out of stealth and blinding them.

27107.name: Impossible Odds
27107.description: Legendary Assassin. Empower yourself with Shiro's incredible speed and destructive prowess, gaining great movement speed and striking foes an additional time when you hit them. This effect can occur once per interval.

27198.name: Dome of the Mists
27198.description: Create an area that blocks projectiles and weakens foes.

27220.name: Facet of Light
27220.description: Legendary Dragon. Facet. Place the Facet of Light on yourself to grant nearby allies regeneration every few seconds.

27228.name: Infuse Light
27228.description: Legendary Dragon. Consume. Consume Facet of Light to heal yourself and convert all incoming strikes to heals for a short duration.

27322.name: Pain Absorption
27322.description: Legendary Demon. Grant resistance to yourself and nearby allies. Absorb conditions from those allies, gaining resolution and additional resistance per condition.

27356.name: Energy Expulsion
27356.description:
Legendary Centaur. Force energy to erupt from the tablet, knocking down nearby foes and healing nearby allies. 

If this skill is empowered, grant stability to allies near the tablet.

27372.name: Soothing Stone
27372.description: Legendary Dwarf. Remove conditions and heal yourself. Gain resolution.

27505.name: Banish Enchantment
27505.description: Legendary Demon. Deal damage, apply chill, and remove boons from your foe.

27628.name: Diminish Solace
27628.description: Collapse the protective barrier that formed around the tablet.

27665.name: Field of the Mists
27665.description: Create a field from the Mists that blocks incoming projectiles in front of you, then fire bolts at foes around your target.

27715.name: Purifying Essence
27715.description:
Legendary Centaur. Remove conditions from allies near the tablet, and heal them for a small amount per condition removed. 

If this skill is empowered, remove additional conditions from allies.

27760.name: Facet of Chaos
27760.description: Legendary Dragon. Facet. Place the Facet of Chaos on yourself to grant nearby allies protection every few seconds.

27917.name: Call to Anguish
27917.description: Legendary Demon. Leap toward the targeted area and pull foes toward your landing point.

27964.name: Echoing Eruption
27964.description: Leap at your foe and deliver a massive attack that cascades outward.

27975.name: Rite of the Great Dwarf
27975.description: Legendary Dwarf. Channel the power of the Rite of the Great Dwarf to turn yourself and nearby allies to stone to reduce incoming damage.

27976.name: Phase Smash
27976.description: Leap through the Mists to the target area. When you land, damage and chill foes in an area, then teleport back to your previous location.

28029.name: Frigid Blitz
28029.description: Hurl your axe at your target, damaging and chilling the foes the axe passes through. When the axe reaches your target, shadowstep to it and deliver a large blow.

28075.name: Chaotic Release
28075.description: Legendary Dragon. Consume. Consume Facet of Chaos, releasing chaotic winds damaging and knocking back foes while granting superspeed to allies. Facet of Chaos will be disabled while this skill is recharging.

28085.name: Legendary Dragon Stance
28085.description: Invoke the power of the legendary dragon Glint.

28110.name: Drop the Hammer
28110.description: Summon a massive hammer from the Mists to strike the ground. Recharge Coalescence of Ruin if you strike an enemy.

28113.name: Burst of Strength
28113.description: Legendary Dragon. Consume. Consume Facet of Strength, granting increased damage for successful hits. Facet of Strength will be disabled while this skill is recharging.

28134.name: Legendary Assassin Stance
28134.description: Invoke the power of the legendary assassin Shiro Tagachi.

28195.name: Legendary Centaur Stance
28195.description: Invoke the power of the legendary centaur Ventari.

28219.name: Empowering Misery
28219.description: Legendary Demon. Heal yourself. Gain might and heal more for each condition currently applied to you.

28231.name: Phase Traversal
28231.description: Legendary Assassin. Step through the Mists to your target. Your next few attacks can't be blocked.

28253.name: Coalescence of Ruin
28253.description: Slam the ground with your hammer, creating a cascading eruption of energy.

28262.name: Crystal Hibernation
28262.description: Channel a shield from the Mists to protect you, blocking attacks and regenerating the health of nearby allies.

28287.name: Embrace the Darkness
28287.description: Legendary Demon. Summon the power of the legendary demon to transform into a powerful avatar. Pulse torment to nearby foes. Using skills that cost energy increases the torment applied on the next pulse.

28357.name: Searing Fissure
28357.description: Smash your mace into the ground, causing flames to erupt from the Mists. The first strike of this attack is more powerful.

28379.name: Facet of Darkness
28379.description: Legendary Dragon. Facet. Place the Facet of Darkness on yourself to grant nearby allies fury every few seconds.

28382.name: Relinquish Power
28382.description: Legendary Assassin. End the Impossible Odds skill.

28406.name: Jade Winds
28406.description: Legendary Assassin. Call upon the Jade Wind to turn nearby enemies into jade, stunning them for a short duration.

28409.name: Temporal Rift
28409.description: Slice into the Mists, creating an unstable rift. After a short duration, this rift will collapse in on itself, pulling in enemies.

28419.name: Legendary Dwarf Stance
28419.description: Invoke the power of the legendary dwarf King Jalis Ironhammer.

28427.name: Ventari's Will
28427.description: Legendary Centaur. Will the tablet toward the target location.

28472.name: Shackling Wave
28472.description: Slice through the air, sending a wave of energy from the Mists toward your foe and dealing rapid strikes. Immobilize duration is increased per target you strike.

28494.name: Legendary Demon Stance
28494.description: Invoke the power of the legendary demon Mallyx the Unyielding.

28516.name: Inspiring Reinforcement
28516.description: Legendary Dwarf. Create a stone road that damages and weakens foes as it's created. Once it's created it will pulse, granting stability to allies.

28549.name: Hammer Bolt
28549.description: Hurl your weapon at enemies, striking foes in its path.

28571.name: Duelist's Preparation
28571.description: Assume a defensive stance, blocking incoming attacks.

28692.name: Igniting Brand
28692.description: Throw your spear at your foe. Upon impact, damage your foe and connect to them through the Mists. While the connection is active it will apply burning.

28714.name: Spear of Anguish
28714.description: Throw a mist spear toward your foe, inflicting increasing durations of torment the closer the foe is to you.

28797.name: Frigid Discharge
28797.description: Detonate the sphere to cause it to explode, damaging and chilling foes.

28815.name: Devour Brand
28815.description: Step through the Mists toward the branded foe, dealing damage in an area to nearby foes.

28827.name: Venomous Sphere
28827.description: Launch a sphere outward from the Mists. The sphere will attack nearby foes as it travels, poisoning them.

28915.name: Rapid Assault
28915.description: Rapidly strike foes in front of you, inflicting vulnerability.

28930.name: Rift Containment
28930.description: Create two rifts, one above and one below your target. After a short delay, these rifts will create a barrier from the Mists, preventing foes from crossing.

28964.name: Rift Slash
28964.description: Slash foes, creating a rift on them that explodes for additional damage after a short delay.

28978.name: Surge of the Mists
28978.description: Charge forward, knocking back enemies that cross your path.

29002.name: Rejuvenating Assault
29002.description: Cleave foes around you with your staff, healing nearby allies.

29057.name: Preparation Thrust
29057.description: Stab your foe with your sword, inflicting vulnerability.

29082.name: Natural Harmony
29082.description:
Legendary Centaur. Collect energy, pulling it into the tablet to build up its power. After a short delay the energy will be released, healing nearby allies. 

If this skill is empowered, healing is increased and endurance is granted to affected allies.

29114.name: Energy Expulsion
29114.description:
Legendary Centaur. Force energy to erupt from the tablet, knocking down nearby foes and healing nearby allies. 

If this skill is empowered, grant stability to allies near the tablet.

29145.name: Mender's Rebuke
29145.description: Smash the ground in front of you to damage foes. After a delay, allies in the area are healed. Heals for more if an enemy was struck.

29148.name: Project Tranquility
29148.description:
Project Ventari's Tablet into the world. The tablet will heal allies near it every few seconds.
(The tablet will disappear if you move outside the tether distance.)

29180.name: Rapid Swipe
29180.description: Swipe your staff at your foe.

29197.name: Purifying Essence
29197.description:
Legendary Centaur. Remove conditions from allies near the tablet, and heal them for a small amount per condition removed. 

If this skill is empowered, remove additional conditions from allies.

29209.name: Riposting Shadows
29209.description: Legendary Assassin. Dodge backward through the Mists. Remove movement-impairing conditions, and gain fury.

29233.name: Chilling Isolation
29233.description: Strike all nearby foes, then release a burst of mist energy that deals a second strike. The second strike deals bonus damage if it hits only one enemy.

29256.name: Brutal Blade
29256.description: Slice foes, damaging them and inflicting vulnerability.

29288.name: Warding Rift
29288.description: Create a rift from the Mists that blocks incoming attacks. When the rift closes it blinds foes in front of you.

29321.name: Renewing Wave
29321.description: Release a burst of Mists energy that heals and removes conditions from allies. Create a healing orb for each ally that loses conditions.

29331.name: Forceful Bash
29331.description: Bash your foe with your staff.

29371.name: Facet of Nature
29371.description: Legendary Dragon. Facet. Place the Facet of Nature on yourself to grant nearby allies enhancements based on your channeled legend.

29386.name: Envoy of Exuberance
29386.description: Send the energy of Glint toward the target area, releasing a burst of energy that heals allies and grants boons.

29393.name: True Nature
29393.description: Legendary Dragon. Consume. Consume Facet of Nature to unify allies, granting them your boons. Facet of Nature will be disabled while this skill is recharging.

32588.name: Rite of the Great Dwarf
32588.description: Legendary Dwarf. Channel the power of the Rite of the Great Dwarf to turn yourself and nearby allies to stone to reduce incoming damage.

40175.name: Bloodbane Path
40175.description: Conjure a portal through the Mists and fire barbed arrows to strike from unexpected directions at your enemy.

40485.name: Icerazor's Ire
40485.description:
Legendary Renegade. Summon Visk Icerazor from the Mists to magically bombard your enemies with debilitating conditions.

Band Together. After using this skill, your next Legendary Renegade skill activates instantly and is enhanced. When this skill is enhanced it also inflicts chilled on enemies that it strikes.

40497.name: Shattershot
40497.description: Release an arrow that shatters upon striking, inflicting bleeding on nearby foes.

41220.name: Darkrazor's Daring
41220.description:
Legendary Renegade. Summon Kus Darkrazor to disrupt your enemies.

Band Together. After using this skill, your next Legendary Renegade skill activates instantly and is enhanced. When this skill is enhanced it also grants resistance to nearby allies.

41513.name: Citadel Bombardment
41513.description: Citadel Order. Open a portal through the mists of time, unleashing a storm of artillery from the united legions.

41820.name: Scorchrazor
41820.description: Unleash a fiery edge to ignite and knock down your enemies.

41829.name: Sevenshot
41829.description: Conjure a focused volley of arrows to harass your foes.

41858.name: Legendary Renegade Stance
41858.description: Invoke the power of the legendary charr renegade, Kalla Scorchrazor.

42836.name: Citadel Bombardment
42836.description: Citadel Order. Open a portal through the mists of time, unleashing a storm of artillery from the united legions.

42949.name: Razorclaw's Rage
42949.description:
Legendary Renegade. Summon Centurion Jas Razorclaw from the Mists to strike nearby enemies and enhance the attacks of your allies.

Band Together. After using this skill, your next Legendary Renegade skill activates instantly and is enhanced. When this skill is enhanced it also inflicts torment on enemies that it strikes.

43993.name: Spiritcrush
43993.description: Create a debilitating zone by firing a volley of flaming arrows at an area.

44076.name: Heroic Command
44076.description: Citadel Order. Refresh the duration of your Kalla's Fervor and grant nearby allies might for every stack.

45537.name: Orders from Above
45537.description: Citadel Order. Orders from above arrive, renewing your abilities and those of your nearby allies.

45686.name: Breakrazor's Bastion
45686.description:
Legendary Renegade. Summon Era Breakrazor to heal your allies while shielding them from condition damage.

Band Together. After using this skill, your next Legendary Renegade skill activates instantly and is enhanced. When this skill is enhanced, it also grants barrier to nearby allies.

45773.name: Soulcleave's Summit
45773.description:
Legendary Renegade. Summon Lieutenant Ofela Soulcleave to grant your allies' strikes incredible bloodthirst, inflicting damage and restoring health. Soulcleave will also strike enemies and heal allies in the area when you use a Legendary Renegade skill.
Lieutenant Soulcleave can only empower players to siphon life once per interval, and this does not benefit nonplayers.

46409.name: Legendary Renegade Stance
46409.description: Invoke the power of the legendary charr renegade, Kalla Scorchrazor.

46843.name: Call of the Dwarf
46843.description: Strike enemies around you, inflicting weakness, gaining barrier, and gaining additional barrier per target hit.

46849.name: Call of the Renegade
46849.description: Strike enemies around you, inflicting bleeding and gaining Kalla's Fervor. Gain additional fervor stacks for each foe you hit.

46854.name: Call of the Assassin
46854.description: Strike enemies around you, inflicting vulnerability and gaining quickness. Gain additional quickness for each foe you hit.

46856.name: Call of the Demon
46856.description: Strike enemies around you, inflicting conditions on struck foes.

46857.name: Call of the Dragon
46857.description: Strike enemies around you, inflicting multiple conditions.

50390.name: Rift of Pain
50390.description: Saturate your target, creating a chilling area around them with a field type based on which legend you are attuned to upon casting. Allies in the affected area gain beneficial effects.

50395.name: Mistsfire
50395.description: Unleash the Mists toward your enemies, changing effects based on your current legend.

50410.name: Reckoning Blast
50410.description: Release a blast of Mists energy that heals allies and knocks enemies back, infusing your foes with dangerous power. Inflict conditions based on your current legend each time a target is struck.

50456.name: Portal Fire
50456.description: Open the Mists around you to fire multiple projectiles at your enemy, with a chance to inflict conditions based on your current legend.

50483.name: Torrential Mists
50483.description: Release the Mists from your aura with a chance to inflict conditions based on your current legend.

51667.name: True Nature
51667.description: Legendary Dragon. Consume. Strip boons from nearby enemies.

51675.name: True Nature
51675.description: Legendary Dragon. Consume. Grant stability to nearby allies.

51696.name: True Nature
51696.description: Legendary Dragon. Consume. Increase the duration of allies' boons. Remove conditions from allies.

51713.name: True Nature
51713.description: Legendary Dragon. Consume. Cleanse conditions from nearby allies. Heal for each condition removed.

51714.name: True Nature
51714.description: Legendary Dragon. Consume. Transfer conditions to nearby enemies. Gain might for each condition transferred.

55029.name: Ancient Echo
55029.description: Refresh your bond with your channeled legend, gaining energy and legend-specific effects.

59591.name: Invoke Torment
59591.description: Charge up and release a burst of torment energy on nearby foes.

62680.name: Selfless Spirit
62680.description: Legendary Alliance. Heal allies in an area.

62687.name: Urn of Saint Viktor
62687.description: Legendary Alliance. Become the Urn of Saint Viktor, taking continuous damage while healing nearby allies. You take reduced damage while in this state, but you cannot be healed.

62688.name: Mist Slash
62688.description: Swing your greatsword again, inflicting vulnerability.

62689.name: Saint's Shield
62689.description: Drop from above, granting barrier and healing to allies in the affected area.

62692.name: Mist Unleashed
62692.description: Hurl forces from the Mists in front of you, rendering foes vulnerable.

62693.name: Death Drop
62693.description: Drop from above, delivering a massive strike on the focused area.

62702.name: Battle Dance
62702.description: Legendary Alliance. Evade backward, granting boons to allies.

62705.name: Call of the Alliance
62705.description: Gain endurance and strike enemies around you, gaining bonus endurance for each enemy struck.

62719.name: Selfish Spirit
62719.description: Legendary Alliance. Channel your rage into the nearby area, healing and empowering yourself for each enemy struck.

62729.name: Alliance Tactics
62729.description: Swap your Legendary Alliance Stance skills.

62738.name: Drop Urn of Saint Viktor
62738.description: Slam your Urn into the ground, ending the ability. Grant boons and heals allies based on your health threshold.

62752.name: Arcing Mists
62752.description: Cleave your foes, inflicting vulnerability and chilling them.

62796.name: Awakening
62796.description: Legendary Alliance. Break stun on nearby allies and grant protection.

62828.name: True Strike
62828.description: Strike your foes with empowered energy. Deals increased damage based on attacks blocked by Imperial Guard.

62832.name: Nomad's Advance
62832.description: Legendary Alliance. Lunge forward, damaging foes and gaining might for each target struck.

62859.name: Imperial Impact
62859.description: Drop from above, delivering a powerful attack to enemies while granting boons to allies.

62878.name: Reaver's Rage
62878.description: Legendary Alliance. Break stun and attack nearby enemies, gaining stability for each target struck.

62891.name: Legendary Alliance Stance
62891.description: Invoke the power of the legendary champions Archemorus and Saint Viktor.

62895.name: Phantom's Onslaught
62895.description: Rush toward your opponent, cleaving the area.

62913.name: Mist Swing
62913.description: Swing at enemies with your greatsword.

62921.name: Imperial Guard
62921.description: Block incoming attacks for a prolonged duration, and ready a counterattack that deals increased damage based on the attacks blocked.

62929.name: Eternity's Requiem
62929.description:
Whirl your greatsword, opening holes in the Mists that deal damage.

Damage is reduced per target each time they are struck by this skill.

62941.name: Tree Song
62941.description: Legendary Alliance. Grant regeneration and cleanse conditions from allies in the targeted area, healing them for each condition removed. Gain endurance for each affected ally, and gain additional endurance for each condition removed.

62942.name: Spear of Archemorus
62942.description: Legendary Alliance. Call upon the spirit of Archemorus to hurl his spear at your foe, dealing significant damage.

62962.name: Scavenger Burst
62962.description: Legendary Alliance. Unleash your rage at foes in the area, gaining boons and endurance for each foe struck.

71816.name: Blossoming Aura
71816.description: Envelop target friend or foe with energy from the Mists. The energy explodes outward after a short delay or when manually detonated, granting barrier to nearby allies. The amount of barrier granted increases over time. If targeting an enemy, the aura also deals damage over time, and it does additional damage when the aura explodes based on how long the aura lasts.

71930.name: Acerbic Cut
71930.description: Slash at enemies again with Mists energy. Grant boons to allies after striking an enemy.

71933.name: Serene Slash
71933.description: Condense Mists energy into a solid form to strike enemies in front of you.

71942.name: Motivating Whirl
71942.description: Whirl around, damaging enemies and granting barrier to allies if an enemy is struck.

71952.name: Otherworldly Bond
71952.description: Form a tether through the Mists to a target ally or enemy. The strength of the tether increases over time. You can only be tethered to one target at a time, and the link is severed if you are too far away from your target or when you swap weapons.

72359.name: Icerazor's Ire
72359.description: Legendary Renegade. Summon Visk Icerazor from the Mists to magically bombard your enemies with debilitating conditions.

72363.name: Razorclaw's Rage
72363.description: Legendary Renegade. Summon Centurion Jas Razorclaw from the Mists to strike nearby enemies and enhance the attacks of your allies.

72366.name: Darkrazor's Daring
72366.description:
Legendary Renegade. Summon Kus Darkrazor to disrupt your enemies.

Band Together. After using this skill, your next Legendary Renegade skill activates instantly and is enhanced. When this skill is enhanced it also grants resistance to nearby allies.

72389.name: Breakrazor's Bastion
72389.description: Legendary Renegade. Summon Era Breakrazor to heal your allies while shielding them from condition damage.

72931.name: Abyssal Fire
72931.description: Ranged. Hurl your weapon at your foe. If you are in close range, swing your weapon at them instead. Striking a foe reduces the cooldown of Abyssal Raze once per skill use.

72938.name: Abyssal Blitz
72938.description: Dash in a direction and slightly recharge Abyssal Raze while leaving portals in your wake that detonate when foes walk over them.

72954.name: Abyssal Blot
72954.description: Unleash gravitational Mist forces on your targeted area that initially pulls foes toward the center. Abyssal Raze's cooldown is reduced for each target you attempt to pull.

72972.name: Abyssal Force
72972.description: Hurl your spear toward your foes, inflicting area damage and conditions on targets struck. Striking at least one foe causes Abyssal Raze to receive a large recharge reduction.

73015.name: Abyssal Strike
73015.description: Melee. Hurl your weapon at your foe. If you are in close range, swing your weapon at them instead. Striking a foe reduces the cooldown of Abyssal Raze once per skill use.

73059.name: Abyssal Raze
73059.description: Attack foes in the target area, inflicting them with conditions. Gain stacks of Crushing Abyss for each target struck, up to the maximum.

76497.name: Replenishing Despair
76497.description: Siphon health from nearby enemies when you gain a dark aura. Siphon healing is reduced for each target struck beyond the first.

76503.name: Unyielding Impact
76503.description: Slam the ground, creating a powerful impact that inflicts conditions on foes in the area.

76610.name: Legendary Entity Stance
76610.description: Invoke the power of the legendary entity of the Mists, Razah.

76968.name: Twin Moon Sweep
76968.description:
Spawn a Fragment of Razah at your targeted location. Both you and the fragment attack with a scythe, damaging and inflicting conditions on foes at your locations. Gain might for each enemy struck.

Resonance. This skill gains bonus effects depending on the legend equipped in the other slot.

77043.name: Shielding Hands
77043.description:
Channel revitalizing energy that heals you with every pulse. While channeling, you take reduced strike and condition damage.

Resonance. If Legendary Centaur Stance is equipped, you additionally heal allies around you during channeling, and you take reduced strike and condition damage for a short amount of time after channeling completes.

77141.name: Beguiling Haze
77141.description:
Send an unblockable fragment of Razah toward the targeted area. When the fragment reaches its target, shadowstep to its position, dealing damage to enemies in the area. If it hits, you can use this skill up to two more times with no energy cost or casting time.

Resonance. If Legendary Assassin Stance is equipped, this skill deals additional damage and removes boons if only one enemy was struck by this attack.

77159.name: Beguiling Haze
77159.description:
Send an unblockable fragment of Razah toward the targeted area. When the fragment reaches its target, shadowstep to its position, dealing damage to enemies in the area. If it hits, you can use this skill up to two more times with no energy cost or casting time.

Resonance. If Legendary Assassin Stance is equipped, this skill deals additional damage and removes boons if only one enemy was struck by this attack.

77243.name: Hex-Eater Vortex
77243.description:
Remove conditions on yourself, then fire projectiles that inflict conditions at random enemies within your radius, based on the number of conditions removed. 

Resonance. If Legendary Demon Stance is equipped, the maximum number of projectiles is always fired regardless of conditions removed, and all projectiles are fired at the closest enemy instead.

77291.name: Gladiator's Defense
77291.description:
Break out of stun, damaging and weakening enemies close to you. Gain boons if this skill strikes at least one enemy. Remove additional energy if this skill was used to break a stun. 

Resonance. If Legendary Dwarf Stance is equipped, the additional energy cost for breaking stuns is reduced, and the boons are also granted to allies in a radius around you.

77371.name: Cosmic Wisdom
77371.description: Tap into your connection with the Mists, empowering your legends for a short period of time.

78501.name: Release Potential: Monk
78501.description: If Ventari's Tablet has not been summoned, summon it at your location; otherwise, gain tranquility. Grant boons to allies around the tablet. Gain energy depending on the number of allies affected by this skill (excluding yourself). For each point of affinity, boon duration is increased.

78505.name: Pain Absorption
78505.description: Legendary Demon. Grant resistance to yourself and nearby allies. Absorb conditions from those allies, gaining resolution and additional resistance per condition.

78587.name: Banish Enchantment
78587.description: Legendary Demon. Deal damage, apply chill, and remove boons from your foe.

78615.name: Release Potential: Mesmer
78615.description: Create an eruption of despair around you, inflicting torment on enemies and dazing them. For each enemy struck, inflict torment on yourself. Each point of affinity you have increases the torment duration on enemies and reduces the torment duration on yourself.

78681.name: Empowering Misery
78681.description: Legendary Demon. Heal yourself. Gain might and heal more for each condition currently applied to you.

78845.name: Release Potential: Assassin
78845.description: Spin around and send out three increasingly larger shockwaves that damage and inflict conditions on enemies around you. Enemies that are struck by all three waves are additionally immobilized. Damage and immobilize duration increase with each point of affinity you have.

78895.name: Release Potential: Warrior
78895.description: Leap to targeted area, damaging enemies at the target location. Gain barrier if at least one enemy was struck. Each point of affinity increases damage dealt and the barrier granted by this skill.
